key.name: max-items
key.description: How many recent applications and how many recent documents the menu shows.

key.name: recent-apps
key.description: Application IDs, most recently used first. Filled automatically when windows get focus.

key.name: show-in-app-grid
key.summary: Show recent applications in the app grid
key.description: Adds a row of recently used applications above the app grid of the overview.

key.name: show-documents-in-app-grid
key.summary: Show recent documents in the app grid
key.description: Adds a row of recently opened documents above the app grid of the overview.

key.name: show-in-panel
key.description: Shows the recent items menu from an icon in the top bar.

key.name: show-in-dash
key.description: Keeps the Recent Items launcher pinned to the Dash. Unpinning it from the Dash turns this off.

key.name: dash-pinned
key.description: Set once the Recent Items launcher has been pinned to the Dash, so it is not pinned again after the user removes it.
